result.note: Tests the first-time flight test of KAL, an indigenous long-range loitering munition, and its range and class.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, IG Defence flight-tested KAL, described as India's first indigenous long-range attack drone. Consider the following statements about KAL:
items: It is a loitering munition with a range of 1,000 km.
It is in the same class as the American MQ-9 Reaper.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: KAL is a 1,000 km loitering munition, but it is placed in the same class as the Iranian Shahed, not the MQ-9 Reaper. The flight test took place on 22 September 2026.
questions.source: a 1,000 km loitering munition in the same class as the Iranian Shahed
